source: direct user response to the immediately preceding temporal usefulness question
interpretation: A development/usefulness target of at most one second between usable same-physical-interface Oil observations within separately qualified visible moving intervals.

scope.time: Use elapsed source timestamps; equality at one second is within the target. Row counts, input FPS and report bridges are not this quantity.
scope.identity: Numeric validity alone is not reviewed same-interface correspondence or scalar qualification. Keep wrong-target, unverified and missing observations separate.
scope.bounds: Retain leading/trailing and all-unavailable spans separately; no pairs does not mean success. Do not bridge an unqualified scene, role or identity transition.
scope.source: Unobservable intervals stay unassessable. A deadline never permits interpolation, carry, branch substitution or a forced number.
scope.not_transferred: No automatic Foam episode timing, stationary/obscured-scene requirement, pixel tolerance, classifier operating point, temporal-window or sampling-setting change.
scope.acceptance: This product target is not demonstrated observability, an O2 operating point or Windows/field acceptance.
